title: Homotopy maps from a family of single objects compute Hom-presheaf homology
statement: Let C be any category, D an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], A:C→D any functor, L an integer-indexed cochain complex in D, and n an integer. Define E:D→(Cᵒᵖ→Ab) by E(B)(U)=Hom_D(A(U),B), with restriction by precomposition and covariant action by postcomposition. Let P be the complex obtained by applying E termwise to L. The presheaf U↦Hom_{K(D)}(A(U)[0],L[n]), with restriction by A on arrows, is naturally isomorphic to the degree-n homology presheaf of P. K(D) is the category of cochain complexes modulo chain homotopy, and [0] denotes the complex with its only nonzero term in degree zero. No resolutions, injectivity or boundedness are assumed.

proof.text: Cochain.fromSingleEquiv identifies the Hom complex out of A(U)[0] with evaluation at U of the termwise Hom presheaf complex. Compatibility with differentials is delta_fromSingleMk. Compatibility with restriction maps is fromSingleMk_precomp.

Construct precomposition on cochains, cocycles and their quotient by coboundaries. delta_ofHom_comp proves it preserves coboundaries. The resulting LeftHomologyMapData proves naturality of leftHomologyData.homologyIso; equivHomShift_symm_precomp proves naturality of CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv. Compose these identifications with the preceding complex isomorphism to identify the homotopy presheaf with the objectwise homology of the Hom complex.

Evaluation is exact and preserves homology. ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans applied to the evaluation transformation for an arrow gives naturality in the evaluated object. Its mapHomologyIso components therefore assemble into a presheaf isomorphism. Compose it with the preceding isomorphism.

theorem singleHomotopyPresheaf_homology
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian D] (A : C ⥤ D) (L : CochainComplex D ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((A ⋙ CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0 ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).op ⋙
          preadditiveYoneda.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).obj (L⟦n⟧)) ≅
        (((restrictedHomPresheafFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L).homology
          n)
